processes.script_summary: Runs FastQC quality control on each input reads file, emitting one HTML report and one archive zip per input file.

inputs.name: multiqc_files
inputs.description: Aggregated report inputs: versions YAML, workflow summary YAML, methods description YAML, config, logo, replace/sample names

processes.script_summary: Aggregates all collected QC inputs (FastQC reports, samtools stats, versions YAML, workflow summary) into one MultiQC HTML report.

inputs.name: reads

outputs.name: reads

processes.script_summary: Concatenates mapped and unmapped FASTQ R1s (and R2s for paired-end) per sample and gzip-compresses; even-index files become R1, odd-index R2.

test_candidates.name: -profile test_full
test_candidates.rationale: Profile-level candidate: conf/test_full.config is realistic-scale; no pipeline-level nf-test file exists for it in tests/ (no test_full.nf.test found); kept as deferred scope evidence.

test_selection.rationale: tests/default.nf.test is the sole primary-coverage whole-pipeline case: default parameter surface (no chr, no collate_fast, QC and stats on), 2 paired BAM samples, and the snapshot carries expected md5 checksums for the merged FASTQ reads, samtools stats outputs, fastqutils markers, and multiqc citations. The remaining candidates each toggle one switch (chr, cram, collate_fast, fai, no_bai, no_crai, no_qc, no_stats) and are preserved as eligible bootstrap-only evidence for those branches.
